description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer reflow checkpoint: safe Rust now preserves Microsoft TextBuffer::Reflow trailing-attribute semantics across width/height changes, including colored trailing spaces, erased rows, forced-wrap shrink and de-flow growth.

entries.notes: Rust exercises the complete Microsoft dx={-1,0,1} by dy={-1,0,1} matrix and preserves per-row background tails, a two-cell surrogate-pair glyph, and the fully colored erased row through reflow.
Shrinking 80→65 columns wraps the 70 red A cells plus green-spaced BBB segment exactly, including the source row's trailing green space and default attribute fill on the destination continuation row.

Growing 80→95 columns de-flows the forced-wrap chain into one row and preserves the final source row's green trailing space followed by default attributes, matching Microsoft's native Reflow behavior.
